title: Uniform lower tensor bound for proper-support direct image
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to S be a morphism locally of finite type, and let E be an object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume E is bounded with coherent cohomology sheaves, every cohomology sheaf of E has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and E has finite Tor dimension as an object of D(f^{-1}\mathcal O_S). Then there is an integer a such that for every quasi-coherent structure-sheaf module F on S and every i<a, H^i(Rf_*E\otimes^L F)=0 [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes].

source.place: Tag 08EV, lemma-perfect-direct-image, proof: quasi-compact support reduction and final projection-formula lower-bound argument (uses Tags 08EU and 08DZ)

proof.text: Apply the relative Tor lower-bound lemma to get a uniform integer a, with E tensor Lf*F cohomologically >= a for every module F.

For quasi-coherent F apply the proper-support derived projection isomorphism. The proved private helper directImage_isGE uses bounded-below right-derived compatibility and the upstream bound theorem to retain the same lower endpoint a after direct image. Transport zero homology through the projection isomorphism and use the proved private helper tensor_vanishes_of_isZero: choose a K-flat resolution, use the derived tensor comparison, and transport homology vanishing to the defining predicate.

theorem exists_schemeDerivedDirectImage_tensor_lower_bound
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hcoherent : ∀ i : ℤ,
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ,
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hTor : HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f E) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ i : ℤ, i < a →
        schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) F i
